title: RTX-Zig: High-Performance Ray Tracer
description: CPU-based ray tracer in Zig implementing multi-material rendering, anti-aliasing and depth of field with SIMD optimizations. Features advanced Zig language patterns including comptime, tagged unions, and vector operations.

title: Transformer Attention Visualizer
description: Research tool for analyzing transformer attention patterns in DistilBERT. Implements efficient inference caching and interactive visualization to facilitate mechanistic interpretability research of attention heads and layer behaviors.

title: LangGraph Multi-Agent Travel System
description: Production-grade multi-agent system using LangGraph to orchestrate 10+ specialized LLM agents for automated travel presentation generation. Implements advanced workflow orchestration with quality control, multi-LLM routing, and intelligent task delegation.
